data.narrative:
Intramotev is a Series A drone and autonomous systems company founded by Tim Luchini, Alex Peiffer, and Corey Vasel. The company has raised $14.4M to date. The comparable universe in Drones & Autonomous includes eight private companies (Zipline, Joby Aviation, Nuro, Archer Aviation, Elroy Air, and three others) and no public peers, limiting traditional peer benchmarking.

Stage-progression methodology is the primary applicable valuation tool here. Using total raised ($14.4M) as a base proxy and applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A to next-stage progression yields an implied valuation of $29M. This method proved necessary because the peer set lacks sufficient narrow comparables at identical or adjacent stages with similar valuation tiers—the sector contains five peers, but insufficient density at Intramotev's specific positioning to support median peer multiples with confidence.

The triangulation analysis supports a valuation range of $24M (low) to $33M (high), with a median point of $29M. This relatively tight range reflects reliance on a single method rather than cross-validation across multiple approaches. Key uncertainties include the absence of public-market comparables, sparse private peer data at similar stages, and the early-stage nature of the sector itself, which limits visibility into unit economics and scaling trajectory. Investors should weight this valuation as indicative rather than definitive pending deeper operational due diligence.
